verdict.rationale: Floot's own docs say a credit system exists, with credits added on demand rather than through plan changes. They also state that actions run over MCP use the user's Claude or ChatGPT subscription, not Floot credits, which partly explains what consumes credits. However, there is no per-action credit or token cost breakdown and no description of what each plan includes. Missing for 10: per-action credit/token consumption table, plan inclusions and limits, usage dashboard or metering docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can understand what credits or tokens each action consumes and what my plan includes

citations.quote: you no longer have to upgrade or downgrade your plan — just add credits whenever you need them.
It runs on your existing Claude or ChatGPT subscription over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), not Floot credits.
